title: Real-Time Audio Spectrum Analyzer
bullets: Designed a 5-module Verilog system on a Xilinx Artix-7 FPGA to perform real-time, hardware-accelerated 64-point streaming FFT processing on incoming audio signals
Optimized FPGA resource utilization by implementing an L1 magnitude approximation logic and a custom ping-pong FIFO double-buffer, decoupling UART receive timing from processing to prevent data loss
Architected a tri-device distributed system (Laptop, Raspberry Pi, FPGA) using TCP/IP and high-speed UART (460,800 baud) protocols to stream and analyze live audio data
Developed a multithreaded Python bridge on a Raspberry Pi utilizing non-blocking queue operations and four daemon threads to synchronize bidirectional data streams and eliminate latency

title: Notch Filter PCB
bullets: Designed, simulated, and prototyped an active Twin-T bandstop filter module to suppress the G-string (196 Hz) of an electric guitar by at least 20 dB while ensuring adjacent string frequencies passed unaffected
Designed a 4-layer PCB with power/ground planes and top/bottom signal layers

Parts: Bourns 3296 5k Ω trimmer potentiometers (tuning notch frequency), LM324 op-amp, TC7660 charge pump (dual power rail operation), 9V battery, LED (indicator), passive components (resistors, capacitors)

title: Fabrication Projects
bullets: Neural Probe: Neural probes made of deposited Chromium and Gold on a Silicon wafer
Pressure Sensor: Chromium and Gold Pressure Sensors on a Silicon wafer getting wet etched in a beaker of Potassium Hydroxide

title: Boeing Freshman Design Challenge
bullets: Created an aircraft design pitch for asteroid sample retrieval in the Boeing Freshman Design Challenge hosted at USC.
Presented design to panel of Boeing engineers; placed 4th overall in which top 5 teams present designs.

title: Canvas Final Grade Calculator
bullets: Web extension that fetches your Canvas grade and calculates the final exam score needed for your desired grade.
Received 900+ downloads on Chrome Web Store.
